title: FM Broadcast Modulator Baseband
text: 使用广播 FM 方法进行调制，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample rate (Hz)} 指定输出信号采样率 240e3；{Frequency deviation (Hz)} 指定调制器输出信号频率的峰值偏差 75e3、{Pre-emphasis filter time constant (s)} 指定预加重高通滤波器时间常数 7.5e-05、{Sample rate of audio input signal (Hz)} 指定输入音频信号的采样率、{Stereo audio} 启用立体声调制、{RDS/RBDS modulation} 启用 RDS、{Oversampling factor of RDS/RBDS input}、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Code，按实例取值。

ports.name: In1
ports.summary: 音频信号 N -element column vector | 2-by- N matrix

ports.name: In2
ports.summary: RDS（或 RBDS）信号 N -element column vector | 2-by- N matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: FM 调制基带信号 column vector

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输出信号采样率 240e3 | positive scalar

params.name: Frequency deviation (Hz)
params.values: 调制器输出信号频率的峰值偏差 75e3 | positive scalar

params.name: Pre-emphasis filter time constant (s)
params.values: 预加重高通滤波器时间常数 7.5e-05 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sample rate of audio input signal (Hz)
params.values: 输入音频信号的采样率 48000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stereo audio
params.values: 启用立体声调制的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: RDS/RBDS modulation
params.values: 启用 RDS（或 RBDS）波形调制的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Oversampling factor of RDS/RBDS input
params.values: RDS（或 RBDS）输入信号的过采样因子 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
